scope: One primary-backed elemental-identity qualification of the exact M0212 Step12/o52/source_point/m1.a83 depiction; no replacement mechanism.

reviewers.finding: Primary identity/locators, main-text scope, exact source-capture hash/size/receipt and limits accepted. Supplementary methods are not needed for reported elemental identity.

Reusable qualification accepted. Exact source selectors are separately pinned in the reviewed primary projection; portable and repository validators reject element and selector drift. Actual compact and expanded packaged CLI preserve original flows. Final focused suite 33/33 passed.

Actual compact and expanded CLI qualify only Step12/o52/m1.a83, leaving o51/m1.a34 unchanged. Scientific scope remains elemental identity only.

adjudications.decision: Reject both transfers. Qualify elemental identity only; retain original source flow and current_constraint_usable=false.

adjudications.decision: Bind only the Step12 source depiction. No cross-panel m1.a83 mapping, no experimental atom mapping, no 3U7Q-to-1N2C state/assembly transfer.

adjudications.decision: Require default exact-flow qualification with machine-readable unusability; docs-only or optional-only output is insufficient.

adjudications.decision: Require source-projection/element/identity consistency in repository validation before accepting the runtime.

adjudications.objection: A coherent annotation repin could remap the interstitial-carbon qualification from o52/m1.a83 to substrate-nitrogen o51/m1.a34.
adjudications.decision: Bind the manually curated source-depiction selector separately in the hash-bound projection and require exact equality with annotation/excerpt selectors. This prevents an annotation-only remap against unchanged reviewed inputs. Selection remains manual; rewriting every input and review pin does not become scientific validation.

reconsideration.bespoke_code: One shared missing concept, elemental identity counterevidence against a source actor, rather than an enzyme-ID branch. Case facts remain in the source projection and annotation.
reconsideration.reusable_curation: Existing primary sidecar, source binding, catalog and package paths reused. Source selection, topology-based actor recognition and scientific applicability remain manual; no curation time saving measured.
reconsideration.integrated_value: The same default query exposes the historical actor together with its consequential primary contradiction. No autonomous mechanism-to-function or design-ready chain claimed.

scientific_limits.statement: No experimental mapping from source m1.a83 to a 3U7Q atom, spectroscopic nucleus or another source panel. Scheme-local atom IDs may change.
Carbon identity does not establish or rule out a central-atom/Fe bond change; no replacement electron flow, coordination edit or exact reactive Fe is inferred.
No corrected Step12 pathway, catalytic-state persistence, N2-binding mode or full FeMo/P-cluster mechanism is established.
Carbon species does not assign carbide charge, oxidation/protonation, resting state or a catalytic E state.
The studied A.vinelandii composition is not the 1N2C nucleotide/assembly state, an exact assayed construct, a validated proposal or a design constraint beyond rejection of this elemental depiction.

record_preservation: All raw M-CSA bytes, source-draft records, source arrows, frozen/protected registries and exposure history remain unchanged.

verification.scope: Computational integrity and reviewed source applicability; no independent human or experimental validation.
